title: Sperm Whales Sleep Standing Up, Hanging in the Ocean

scenes.text: Sperm whales sleep standing up. Underwater.
They hang vertically, heads up, just below the surface, in groups of five or six.
Researchers tagged 59 sperm whales and found they nap for 10 to 15 minutes at a time.
All together, that's only about 7 percent of the day.
While they nap, they float motionless.
Most whales sleep horizontally. These giants rest upright.
